customer_id.custom_check_code:
import pandas as pd
import re

def custom_check(series: pd.Series) -> dict:
    pattern = re.compile(r'^USR_\d{5}$')
    null_count = series.isna().sum()
    duplicate_count = series.duplicated().sum()
    invalid_pattern_count = series.dropna().apply(lambda x: not bool(pattern.match(str(x)))).sum()
    
    total_violations = null_count + duplicate_count + invalid_pattern_count
    total_rows = len(series)
    
    if total_violations > 0:
        details = (f"Found {null_count} nulls, {duplicate_count} duplicates, "
                   f"and {invalid_pattern_count} pattern mismatches.")
        return {"passed": False, "metric": f"{total_violations} / {total_rows} violations", "details": details}
    
    return {"passed": True, "metric": "0 violations", "details": "All values conform to quality constraint"}
